title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #17

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Fatiha

2. What did the Prophet say about learning to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Never pray
   B. Pray in any way
   C. Pray quickly
   D. Pray as you have seen me praying

3. Which qualities of the Prophet did Khadija mention? (1 mark)
   A. He is lazy
   B. He is careless
   C. He is rude
   D. He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests

4. What does "Al-Basir" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King
   B. The Most Merciful
   C. The All-Seeing
   D. The All-Hearing

5. What did Khadija notice about Muhammad? (1 mark)
   A. His height
   B. His honesty and trustworthiness
   C. His speed
   D. His wealth

6. What is mud on your clothes? (1 mark)
   A. A light najasa
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. Normal dirt, not a najasa
   D. A medium najasa

7. What happened to Taif later? (1 mark)
   A. It never changed
   B. It disappeared
   C. It was destroyed
   D. Its people accepted Islam in later years

8. Which is a Kenyan Muslim garment for men? (1 mark)
   A. Kanzu
   B. Buibui
   C. Sari
   D. Hijab

9. Which quality did the early converts show? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Loyalty and courage
   C. Greed
   D. Cowardice

10. What should we say to family after entering? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. As-salamu alaykum
   C. Hello only
   D. Nothing

11. Which attribute means Allah is free from all faults? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahim
   B. Al-Basir
   C. Al-Malik
   D. As-Salam

12. What can you do to memorise a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Read it once
   B. Sleep on it
   C. Repeat it line by line with a partner
   D. Never practise

13. What should you do if you find an injured bird? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Kick it
   C. Ask an adult to help
   D. Play with it

14. What did the Prophet say when the angel told him to read? (1 mark)
   A. I am busy
   B. I will read
   C. I cannot read
   D. I am tired

15. What does "destitute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A rich person
   B. A person who has nothing to live on
   C. A farmer
   D. A teacher

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. List the steps of wudhu in order from the hands to the feet. (3 marks)

17. State three virtues the Prophet showed in Taif. (3 marks)

18. How should a Muslim treat dogs even though their saliva is heavy najasa? (3 marks)

19. State two reasons why a Muslim recites Al-Fatiha in every prayer. (2 marks)

20. State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth. (2 marks)

21. Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Al-Fatiha
   It is a pillar.

2. D — Pray as you have seen me praying
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari.

3. D — He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   She praised his character.

4. C — The All-Seeing
   Al-Basir sees everything.

5. B — His honesty and trustworthiness
   That is why she respected him.

6. C — Normal dirt, not a najasa
   Mud is not najasa though we clean for neatness.

7. D — Its people accepted Islam in later years
   A delegation later accepted Islam.

8. A — Kanzu
   Kanzu is a long robe.

9. B — Loyalty and courage
   They stayed firm.

10. B — As-salamu alaykum
   Greet with salaam.

11. D — As-Salam
   As-Salam means He is perfect and free of faults.

12. C — Repeat it line by line with a partner
   Practice helps.

13. C — Ask an adult to help
   Get help from an adult.

14. C — I cannot read
   He was unlettered.

15. B — A person who has nothing to live on
   Destitute means very poor.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to ankles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each three steps in the right order.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience, tolerance, perseverance, mercy, trust in Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kindly, without cruelty, giving them food and water, and only being careful to avoid their saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for not cruel, 1 mark for careful with saliva.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a pillar of the prayer, and it praises Allah and asks Him for guidance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.
